concepts.gloss_en: The two companions that never separate (Zoharic term for the union of yud-heh); the same phrase appears in the second form embedded in a clause 'that the two companions should draw near'

members.note: representative; core phrase, explicitly = בחינת י"ק

identical noun phrase preceded only by the verb שיקרבו ('that they draw near'); lm1:129 explicitly cross-references lm1:101 as the same matter, so same referent; verb is contextual framing, not a new construct head

notes: The second form carries an action verb (שיקרבו) but the concept head is the identical Zoharic phrase, and the text self-identifies it as the same matter from siman 101. Kept together as one concept; if the graph treats action-clauses as distinct nodes, split and note the cross-reference.
